name: Kantata OX
description: Kantata OX is a professional-services automation platform for managing projects, resources, finances and team collaboration. Professional-services organizations use it to plan delivery, allocate people, track time and expenses, collaborate on work and understand project performance.
agentUseSummary: Relay uses a customer-generated Kantata OAuth bearer token only for one fixed metadata-only GET against a preselected project ID. The connector returns project lifecycle state without titles, descriptions, participants, financials or other account data and blocks all other reads, mutations, administration and the duplicate Mavenlink alias.

capabilities.label: Read selected project state
capabilities.description: Read one selected project's ID, stage, archive state and schedule dates.

allowed.label: Read selected project state
allowed.description: Use the fixed individual-workspace route for one selected project and return only bounded lifecycle metadata.

blocked.label: Expose private project data
blocked.description: Titles, descriptions, posts, tasks, files, custom fields, participants, clients, organizations, financials and identities are excluded from Relay output.

blocked.label: Read broader Kantata OX resources
blocked.description: Project lists, other projects, users, resources, allocations, time, expenses, invoices, reports, templates, events and account data are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate Kantata OX
blocked.description: Projects, tasks, posts, files, users, resources, schedules, time, expenses, invoices, permissions, settings and every write or destructive action are blocked.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary Kantata OX calls
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose API origins, paths, includes, filters, optional fields, pagination, bodies or raw REST operations.

blocked.label: Create a separate Mavenlink connection
blocked.description: Mavenlink is the former product name and must resolve to this single Kantata OX authority, credential, policy and lifecycle.

approvalProfiles.label: Selected Project State Read
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected project's bounded lifecycle state; private content, financials, identities, other resources, administration and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Mount one no-input selected-project state reader backed by Railway's fixed-origin Kantata OX adapter.
Mount one no-input selected-project state reader backed by Railway's fixed-origin Kantata OX adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: Kantata requires a paid customer account and Account Administrator to register an OAuth application. Kantata publishes no scopes or token expiry/refresh contract; access tokens do not expire and act with the authorizing user's account and project permissions. Relay therefore cannot become the paying application owner or request a broad global app in this lane, and live acceptance requires a customer-owned disposable app, synthetic selected project and careful permission validation.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console acceptance task, use a paid disposable Kantata OX account with synthetic data, register a customer-owned application, generate a separate token for the intended user, bind one synthetic project ID through Relay, and validate the fixed individual-project request, metadata-only output, other-project and broader-route denial, token revocation by deleting the app, disconnect and post-disconnect denial. Never reuse a production administrator token.

evidence.supports: Kantata's official OpenAPI documents the fixed api.mavenlink.com origin, authorization-code OAuth, non-expiring bearer tokens, structured result references, individual workspace GET route, archived-project filter, rate-limit behavior and broad adjacent read/write surface.
Kantata's API overview states that the API exposes most of the data model, requires an Account Administrator to register applications, uses OAuth2 tokens and applies rate limits.
Official registration guidance defines customer account application creation, bearer-token generation and application deletion as the available token invalidation mechanism.
Official permission documentation defines per-project access levels and additional restrictions for users, supporting exact selected-project authorization validation.
Kantata identifies Mavenlink as the former name of Kantata OX, supporting one canonical connection and the separate source-697 discovery alias decision.
